name: button
title: Button
summary: A button, or a link styled as one.

name: toggle
title: Toggle
summary: A button that stays pressed until it is pressed again, such as Bold in a text toolbar.

name: toggle-group
title: ToggleGroup
summary: A row of related toggles that share one value, such as text alignment or bold, italic and underline in a toolbar.

name: button-group
title: ButtonGroup
summary: Related buttons joined into one control, such as Previous, a page number and Next, or a split button.

name: color-scheme-toggle
title: ColorSchemeToggle
summary: The control that switches the app between light, dark and the system's scheme, and keeps the choice.

name: copy-button
title: CopyButton
summary: A button that puts a piece of text on the clipboard: an API key, a link, a command.

name: share-button
title: ShareButton
summary: A button that shares a link: through the system's share sheet where there is one (phones, Safari), and by copying it where there is not, when it says "Link copied" for two seconds and screen readers hear it once.

name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
summary: A row of controls for one surface, such as an editor's formatting: Button commands and Toggle states, in groups with separators.

name: text
title: Text
summary: Body text in the theme's type scale and colors.

name: heading
title: Heading
summary: A section title, `<h1>` to `<h6>`, in the theme's foreground color.

name: link
title: Link
summary: A text link that navigates through your router.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
summary: A keyboard shortcut, in the reader's platform's notation: `keys={["mod", "k"]}` shows ⌘K on a Mac, iPhone or iPad and Ctrl+K elsewhere.

name: local-date
title: LocalDate
summary: A date (and time) in the reader's own time zone and language, in a `<time>` that carries the exact instant.

name: relative-time
title: RelativeTime
summary: How long ago (or how soon) something happens, in the reader's language: "3 days ago", "yesterday", "in 5 minutes", "now", kept current while it shows.

name: field
title: Field
summary: A labeled form control: the label, an optional description, the control and its error, wired together with ids that match between the server and the browser.

name: fieldset
title: Fieldset
summary: A titled group of related fields, such as an address, rendered as a `<fieldset>` named by its legend.

name: text-field
title: TextField
summary: A labeled one-line text input on the Field contract: pass `label`, and `error` from your server action or client check.

name: text-area
title: TextArea
summary: A labeled multi-line text field on the Field contract, a native `<textarea>`: pass `label`, and `error` from your server action or client check.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
summary: A labeled checkbox on the Field contract, with the label to its right: pass `label`, and `checked` with `onCheckedChange` (or `defaultChecked`).

name: checkbox-group
title: CheckboxGroup
summary: A group of checkboxes under one legend, on the Field contract, for picking any number of choices: pass `legend`, and `options` (or `Checkbox` children).

name: radio-group
title: RadioGroup
summary: A group of radios under one legend, on the Field contract, for picking exactly one choice: pass `legend`, and `options` (or `Radio` children).

name: switch
title: Switch
summary: A labeled on/off switch on the Field contract, with the label to its right: pass `label`, and `checked` with `onCheckedChange` (or `defaultChecked`).

name: form
title: Form
summary: A form that validates with the browser's own constraints (`required`, `type="email"`, `pattern`) and shows server errors on the matching fields.

name: select
title: Select
summary: A labeled list of choices on the Field contract: pass `label`, `options` (or `SelectItem` children) and `error` from your server action or client check.

name: native-select
title: NativeSelect
summary: A labeled native `<select>` on the Field contract: pass `label`, `options` (or `<option>` children) and `error`.

name: number-field
title: NumberField
summary: A labeled number input on the Field contract: pass `label`, and `error` from your server action or client check.

name: slider
title: Slider
summary: A labeled slider on the Field contract: pass `label`, and a `defaultValue` (or `value` with `onValueChange`).

name: combobox
title: Combobox
summary: A text input that filters a list of items as people type, on the Field contract: pass `label`, `items`, and `error` from your server action or client check.

name: otp-field
title: OtpField
summary: A one-time code entry on the Field contract: one slot per character, with focus that moves as the person types, a whole code pasted at once, and `autoComplete="one-time-code"` so phones offer the code from a text message.

name: file-field
title: FileField
summary: A labeled file input with a drop zone, on the Field contract.

name: color-field
title: ColorField
summary: A color on the Field contract: a swatch that opens the system color picker, next to the same color as hex text, kept in step both ways.

name: calendar
title: Calendar
summary: A month grid to pick a day or a range of days, with the arrow keys or a press.

name: date-picker
title: DatePicker
summary: A labeled date field.

name: choice-card
title: ChoiceCard
summary: A set of choices shown as cards, each with a picture, a label and a line of description, for picking exactly one: a cover photo, a plan, a layout.

name: image-cropper
title: ImageCropper
summary: A dialog for cropping a photo to a shape before it is used: drag the photo (or move it the way the arrow keys point) to choose what shows in the frame, zoom with the slider (or Plus and Minus), and Save hands the cropped image to `onCrop` as a `File`, ready for a form or an upload.

name: image-field
title: ImageField
summary: A field for one photo, shown large: the photo already saved (`src`) or the one just chosen, with Choose photo (Change photo once one shows) and Remove.

name: autocomplete
title: Autocomplete
summary: Suggestions at the text caret: typing a trigger character, such as `@` for people or `:` for emoji, in a `TextArea` or `TextField` opens a list beside the caret, filtered by what follows the character.

name: sheet
title: Sheet
summary: A panel that slides in from an edge and is dragged back to dismiss: the mobile form of a dialog.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
summary: A dialog that presents itself for the screen: a centered dialog on wider screens and a bottom sheet you can drag away on phones (below 640px).

name: confirm-dialog
title: ConfirmDialog
summary: Asks the user to confirm an action, with Cancel focused first.

name: edit-sheet
title: EditSheet
summary: Edits something in a form inside a dialog: the whole interaction, done right.

name: popover
title: Popover
summary: A small non-modal panel beside its trigger, for a short form or a few choices: a share link, filters, a quick edit.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
summary: A short label that appears beside its trigger on hover and keyboard focus, for an icon button's purpose or a control's shortcut.

name: hover-card
title: HoverCard
summary: A preview of where a link goes, shown when a mouse rests on the link or the keyboard focuses it: a cook's profile, a recipe's summary.

name: menu
title: Menu
summary: A list of actions that opens from a button, from a right-click or long press, or from a menubar, with one API for all three.

name: command
title: Command
summary: A command palette: a searchable list of every action in the app, in a dialog.

name: toaster
title: Toaster
summary: Shows the toasts you send with `toast("Saved")` from `@/lib/ouro/toast`: render it once, at the root of your app, inside `OuroProvider` if you use one, or alone.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
summary: A spinning ring that says something is loading.

name: progress
title: Progress
summary: A bar that shows how far along a task is, or that it is under way when you can't tell.

name: route-progress
title: RouteProgress
summary: The thin bar across the top of the screen while the app loads the next page or submits a form, so a click that waits on the server never feels frozen: one global affordance instead of a pending state on every action.

name: timer
title: Timer
summary: A countdown timer with its own controls: the time left in large numbers, Start, then Pause and Cancel, Resume when paused, and at zero "Time's up" with Dismiss and Restart.

name: timer-tray
title: TimerTray
summary: The timers that are running, paused or finished, in one strip, so a person who leaves a timer's screen can still see it count down, hear it at zero, and stop it.

name: celebrate
title: Celebrate
summary: A small moment of celebration for something the person finished: confetti bursts from a badge with the message ("List cleared") and screen readers hear the message once.

name: sync-status
title: SyncStatus
summary: One line that says where the person's changes are: Saved, Saving…, Offline (kept on this device) or Couldn't save, each with its icon, and Retry while there is a problem.

name: install-prompt
title: InstallPrompt
summary: A quiet offer to install the web app, shown only where the browser can install it (Chromium on Android and desktops), never while it already runs installed, and not again for two weeks after Not now.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
summary: A shimmering placeholder in the shape of content that is still loading.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
summary: A person's picture, or their initials until it loads or when it fails, in a color picked from the name.

name: badge
title: Badge
summary: A short label for a status, category or count: "Draft", "Vegan", "3".

name: alert
title: Alert
summary: An inline message in the page: something saved, something failed, something to know before going on.

name: separator
title: Separator
summary: A thin line in the theme's border color between groups of content, horizontal or vertical.

name: card
title: Card
summary: A surface that groups one thing's content: a media slot across the top, a title with a description and an action, a body, and a footer.

name: empty
title: Empty
summary: What a list, search or page shows when it has nothing in it: an icon, a title that says what is empty, a sentence on what to do, and the action that does it.

name: description-list
title: DescriptionList
summary: One thing's details as pairs of a term and its value: a recipe's prep time and servings, an order's date and total, an account's email.

name: carousel
title: Carousel
summary: A row of slides the user swipes or steps through with Previous and Next buttons: recipe photos, a few featured cards.

name: code-block
title: CodeBlock
summary: Code or a command on a muted surface in the theme's monospace font, with a caption and a button that copies it.

name: lightbox
title: Lightbox
summary: Thumbnails that open a full-screen image viewer.

name: accordion
title: Accordion
summary: A stack of titles that each open their own content, for FAQs and long settings pages.

name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
summary: One section that opens and closes under its title, such as nutrition facts under a recipe.

name: show-more
title: ShowMore
summary: "Show more" for a long list or a long text.

name: item
title: Item
summary: One row of a list: leading media, a title with a description, and trailing actions.

name: item-group
title: ItemGroup
summary: A list of `Item` rows, with an optional label that names it, lines between the rows, and what to show when it is empty.

name: swipe-actions
title: SwipeActions
summary: A list row with actions beside it that a horizontal swipe reveals: swipe toward the start for the `trailing` actions (Delete, Archive), toward the end for the `leading` ones (Pin).

name: reorderable
title: Reorderable
summary: A list the user puts in order: recipe steps, a queue, favorites.

name: checklist
title: Checklist
summary: A list of things to tick off, such as a recipe's ingredients or a shopping list: each row a checkbox the whole row toggles, with an optional value and action.

name: scroll-area
title: ScrollArea
summary: A scrolling region with a slim scrollbar that matches the theme, inside a height you set.

name: aspect-ratio
title: AspectRatio
summary: A frame that keeps an image, video or map at a fixed shape while its width follows the layout, so the page does not jump when the media loads.

name: stack
title: Stack
summary: Lays its children out top to bottom with an even gap.

name: row
title: Row
summary: Lays its children out side by side with an even gap, centered up and down.

name: resizable
title: Resizable
summary: Panels side by side (or stacked) with a draggable handle between each pair: a file list beside an editor, a preview above a console.

name: page-header
title: PageHeader
summary: The top of a page: its title with an optional line above it (`eyebrow`), a description under it, the page's actions beside it, and a trail and an image above.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
summary: Tabs that switch between panels in place: an accessible tab list with roving focus, arrow-key navigation, a line that slides to the selected tab, and 44px tabs on touch screens.

name: segmented-control
title: SegmentedControl
summary: An iOS-style segmented control: a row of equal segments with a raised thumb that slides to the checked one, for switching how one view shows its content in place, such as list or grid.

name: navbar
title: Navbar
summary: The bar across the top of an app: your brand, the main links and a few controls, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"` and a bar at the start edge, distinct from hover and press highlights.

name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
summary: The column of links down the side of an app, in sections, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"` and a bar at the start edge, distinct from hover and press highlights.

name: sidebar-layout
title: SidebarLayout
summary: The shell of an app with a `Sidebar`: the sidebar beside the page from 640px up, in view while the page scrolls, and a sticky top bar with the sidebar's menu button below 640px.

name: stacked-layout
title: StackedLayout
summary: The shell of an app with a `Navbar`: the bar across the top, in view while the page scrolls, and the page below it in a centered column.

name: auth-layout
title: AuthLayout
summary: The page for signing in, signing up or resetting a password: one `Card` in the middle of the screen, with your brand, the title as the page's `<h1>`, the form, and a line under the card.

name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
summary: The trail from the top of the site to the current page: a labelled `<nav>` with an ordered list of links, the last item marked `aria-current="page"`.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
summary: Page navigation for a long list: Previous, the page numbers with gaps, and Next, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"`.

name: navigation-menu
title: NavigationMenu
summary: A row of links where some open a panel of further links, each with a line of description: the navigation of a site with more pages than fit in a bar.

name: skip-link
title: SkipLink
summary: The "Skip to main content" link a keyboard or screen-reader user meets first on every page, so one Tab and Enter jump past the header and navigation.

name: tab-bar
title: TabBar
summary: The bar of tabs at the bottom of a phone screen: two to five of the app's top-level pages, each an icon over a short label, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"` and an accent wash.

name: navigation-rail
title: NavigationRail
summary: The vertical bar of the app's top-level pages on the start edge of a wide screen, as in a chat or mail app or an editor's activity bar: each item an icon over a short label, the current one with its `currentIcon`, a bar on the rail's edge and `aria-current="page"`.

name: table
title: Table
summary: A data table: a caption, column headers, and rows, from `columns` and `rows` or from parts.

name: chart
title: Chart
summary: A chart drawn in the theme's colors, which people can use without seeing it: a figure named by its `title`, a summary for screen readers, and a table of every value (visible with `showTable`).

name: time-grid
title: TimeGrid
summary: A day, work week or week of hours, with events placed by their times: the calendar grid of a mail or meeting app.

name: message
title: Message
summary: One message in a chat: who wrote it, their avatar and what they wrote, with any attachments under it.

name: message-list
title: MessageList
summary: A conversation: `Message`s in a scrolling, labeled region that opens at the newest one.

name: attachment
title: Attachment
summary: A file attached to a chat message, or waiting to be sent with one: an icon for its kind, its name and size.

name: thread-summary
title: ThreadSummary
summary: The line under a post that leads to its thread: who replied, "N replies" (a button that opens the thread) and when the last reply came.

name: conversation-list
title: ConversationList
summary: A list of conversations to choose from: each row shows the avatar, the title, when the latest message arrived and a line of it, and marks unread conversations with a bold title and a dot.

name: attention-card
title: AttentionCard
summary: Something that waits on the person: a mention, a question asked of them or a request still unanswered.

name: reaction-bar
title: ReactionBar
summary: A message's reactions: each one's emoji and how many chose it, with the person's own pressed and tinted, and quick reactions to add with a single press.

name: composer
title: Composer
summary: A chat message box: text that grows from one line as the person writes, a send button, and room for the rest of a composer, in one frame with one focus outline.

name: emoji-picker
title: EmojiPicker
summary: An emoji picker for reactions and for putting emoji into text.

name: inspector
title: Inspector
summary: X-ray for a page built with Ouro HX: outlines every Ouro component on the page with its name, linked to its docs, and lists them all for keyboard and screen reader users.
